spec.description: Prometheus operational view. Select a scrape job for one SLA proxy state domain. Namespace gauges use the maximum across replicas.

spec.title: Scrape targets UP
spec.description: Number of selected targets currently scraped successfully.

spec.title: Validated alerts and policy skips
spec.description: Validated alert and policy selection skip rates. Repeated notifications contribute to these rates.

spec.title: Occurrence state
spec.description: Namespace gauges overlap. Pending occurrences can also have a hold.

spec.title: Scheduler p95 lag
spec.description: Time from scheduled SLA evaluation to the worker claim.

spec.title: Scheduler, policy and Valkey errors
spec.description: Operational error rates by category and reported reason or operation.

spec.title: Calendar classification at alert start
spec.description: Incoming notification rate classified against the SLA calendar at startsAt.

spec.title: Delivery queue by sink
spec.description: Namespace gauges for queued, claimed and held work. Queued includes delayed retries.

spec.title: Sink attempts by result
spec.description: Sink attempt rate by outcome. Successful calls represent sink acceptance.

spec.title: Committed receipts by sink and action
spec.description: Rate of observed durable delivery receipt commits.

spec.title: Retries and receipt commit failures
spec.description: Retry rate and any failed or fenced persistence of a delivery outcome.

spec.title: Sink call p95 duration
spec.description: 95th percentile sink call duration by sink and action.

spec.title: Webhook 5xx · 15m
spec.description: Estimated server error count over the last 15 minutes.

spec.title: SLA opportunity to delivery p95
spec.description: 95th percentile time from first SLA opportunity to successful firing delivery, observed after the receipt commit.

spec.title: Valkey errors · 15m
spec.description: Failed state-store operations over the last 15 minutes.

spec.title: Held occurrences
spec.description: Namespace-wide occurrences with at least one stored hold.

spec.title: Delivery work due
spec.description: Due bindings, including expired delivery claims eligible for recovery.

spec.title: Delivery work held
spec.description: Namespace-wide held or permanently failed delivery bindings.

spec.title: Target availability
spec.description: 1 means Prometheus scraped the target successfully.

spec.title: Webhook responses
spec.description: Incoming webhook request rate by HTTP response class.

spec.title: Webhook p95 latency
spec.description: 95th percentile webhook handling time by response class.
